name: taskflow
description: A focused MERN + TypeScript task manager with JWT httpOnly-cookie auth

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
